# AGENTS.md — 22-interior-studio

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Atelier Hira**, interior studio, style "Architect's material sample board".
- Stack: Nuxt 4, Vue 3. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `app/content.ts` — materials, schemes, all copy (EN + RU)
- `app/app.vue` — whole page, room SVG and patterns
- `app/assets/main.css` — tokens at the top
- `nuxt.config.ts` — head, fonts, static generate

## How to run
- `npm install          # Node 22.22.3+ (Nuxt 4)`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # nuxt generate → ./dist`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: Room elevation re-dressed by material schemes: walls, floor, sofa, rug and lamp switch to textured swatches (oak, linen, terrazzo, plaster).
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- The interface has no accent colour — colour only comes from materials.
- Materials are data (colour + texture kind) in content.ts; schemes assign them to surfaces.
- Textures are SVG patterns, no image files.
- Ysabeau Light for headlines, PT Mono for spec codes and labels.
- Swatches may tilt; the drawing never does.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
